source: Basic Kanji Book Vol. 1 (基本漢字500)
level_note: Level used in the app for every kanji of this book (decided 2026-10-10): the book does not give JLPT levels, and the 250 kanji of Vol. 1 are about N5 + N4. The per-entry jlpt field is only a reference from unofficial lists and is not used.
jlpt_source: jisho.org (unofficial lists; the book does not give JLPT levels). When jisho gives none, the entry has its own jlpt_source. Only kanji 1-75 have it: it was dropped when the whole book was set to N4
readings: kun in hiragana, on in katakana, as in the book: '-' separates the okurigana (い-きる) or marks a form used inside words (-ガツ); readings in () are rarely used
